decisions.reason: As a recent launch close to the core upholstery range and given its own web page, management is likely to keep backing it because the firm has already invested visibly in it and there is no clear sign yet that weak performance is structural.

This decorative fabric is less visibly committed than A or C, but because it is still close to the established assortment and newly launched, management would probably retain it and interpret any early softness as temporary.

Its own web page, functional flame-retardant specification and strong fit with the firm's contract-curtain business make management especially likely to continue with it rather than reverse course after such a short time.

Although only mentioned on the website and somewhat more niche, it still builds on the firm's existing decorative-textile capabilities, so escalation of commitment and the broad-range strategy favor keeping it for now.

This is a more specialized extension with lower visible commitment, but as a fresh product linked to the firm's design-led collection logic, management would still be inclined to keep it on the market and wait for adoption to develop.
